name: dsdv_idx_txm_grp_vA

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered child of dsdv_idx_tx_n32 SPLIT (TOPK TX y): every input lands in a flop at the pin (RIL re_l/ra_l + ra_q, WDL we_l/wa_l/wd_l, wm_next mask copies); POUT=1 (r2, STW-S81c-TOK5): the output p is a pin flop (the AND-OR of the RDL q_l under bsk1 registered here; the parent ORs pa|pb combinationally into rd, same edge, 0 cycles). A recipe pin stage would add a lookup edge (reference LPX 3).

reset_landing.reason: No reset input: every register of the score-store group is reset-free data (landings, captures, bank-select copies, mask copies with rn tied 1), exactly as in the x/v store; the parent owns the TX reset.
